items: Ask the group to tell the story from last week.

data.text: Read or watch Mark 1:16-20 two times as others listen.

data.html:
Jesus Calls His First Disciples

16 As Jesus walked beside the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and his brother Andrew casting a net into the lake, for they were fishermen.17 “Come, follow me,” Jesus said, “and I will send you out to fish for people.”18 At once they left their nets and followed him.

19 When he had gone a little farther, he saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John in a boat, preparing their nets.20 Without delay he called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed him.

items: What caught your attention or what did you like best? Why?
What is new or has developed at this point in Jesus story?
What do we learn about the humanity or divinity of Jesus from this passage?
How can we live differently now that we know this story?
What is Jesus modeling to us about life and ministry or godly leadership?
Read the story again. Have someone tell the story and ask the group to correct if necessary.

data.text: Jesus had started his ministry about 18 months ago. Now He seeks out and formally calls certain disciples to increased commitment. Jesus invites them to become “fishers of men.” They had already been involved as followers. Now this call is to come closer and learn to become those who multiply disciples. Because this was a great honor for them and their families, they excitedly left everything to do so. Jesus had already modeled to them a disciple-making process by sharing the message about the Kingdom of God. An important part of the process was sharing His very life with them as well.

references.label: Matthew 4:18-22
references.passage:
18 As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon called Peter and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the lake, for they were fishermen.19 “Come, follow me,” Jesus said, “and I will send you out to fish for people.”20 At once they left their nets and followed him.

21 Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat with their father Zebedee, preparing their nets. Jesus called them,22 and immediately they left the boat and their father and followed him.
